name: Imagen 3
description: Google's highest-quality text-to-image model with photorealistic output.
longDescription: Imagen 3 is Google's most capable image generation model, delivering photorealistic output with excellent prompt adherence. It excels at generating detailed scenes, handling text in images, and producing fewer visual artifacts than previous generations.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
response = client.models.generate_images(
    model="imagen-3.0-generate-002",
    prompt="A futuristic cityscape at sunset"
)
response.generated_images[0].image.save("output.png")

codeSnippets.label: JavaScript
cURL
codeSnippets.code:
curl "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/imagen-3:generateImage?key=$GEMINI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"A futuristic cityscape at sunset"}'
